name: Genre Sports
old_description: Sublimation basketball jerseys with premium comfort, bold designs, and full team vibes.
about:
Genre Sports operates a sublimation, cut-and-sew factory in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company draws on over three decades of apparel manufacturing experience, including two decades running large garment factories overseas before establishing the Las Vegas facility.

The factory produces custom team uniforms and apparel — primarily sublimation-printed jerseys, shorts, and DTF transfers — for a range of sports including basketball, football, baseball, wrestling, and esports. Production runs through dye-sublimation printing, laser cutting of fabric panels, and commercial-grade sewing, with all stages controlled in-house.

Customers include wholesale distributors, school districts, community organizations, coaches, and businesses of all sizes. The company serves both team sports and individual athletes across more than a dozen sport categories, from volleyball and hockey to gymnastics and billiards.

Genre Sports emphasizes its Made-in-USA production, American labor, and direct factory pricing. It offers turnaround times from four days to four weeks, with same-day service available for DTF transfers, and provides an in-house design team, 3D preview tool, and mockup approval before manufacturing.
